target.title: feat(durable): add durable runtime core
target.body:
## Context capsule

This is PR2/5 in the durable runtime stack. It implements the durable runtime core on top of canonical PR1 #101828, adding persistent runtime state, recovery/orchestration primitives, gateway/operator surfaces, and tests while preserving the PR1 cleanup behavior.

## Stack position

- Stack item: PR2/5
- Canonical upstream gate: PR1 #101828 is 🦐 gold shrimp / threshold-met.
- PR: #102495
- Branch: `codex/openclaw-durable-runtime-core-v2-pr101828-ready`
- Current head: `e37c3d5840` (`fix(chat): restore pairing QR display block`)
- Intended base: `origin/pr/101828` at `98ffd6a2fb`
- Next dependent PR: PR3 remains gated until PR2 reaches the `gold_shrimp_schrimp` threshold.

## What Problem This Solves

Agent/session work currently has runtime state and lifecycle edges that are difficult to recover, replay, or reason about across process failures. This PR adds the durable runtime core needed to persist task/run state, recover or fan in work safely, expose gateway controls, and keep embedded-agent session effects typed and observable while preserving canonical PR1 cleanup behavior.

## Scope

- Durable runtime model, SQLite store, recovery/fan-in/orchestration primitives, worker surface, and gateway methods.
- Agent/session runtime effects and context refs needed for durable runs.
- Guardrails/tests for schema lifecycle, task completion policy, gateway protocol, and embedded-agent retry behavior.
- Webchat pairing QR display preservation so sensitive QR setup data is displayed transiently without being persisted into transcript history.

## Explicit Non-Scope

- Does not submit PR3 durable agent restart/upgrade proof.
- Does not submit PR4 schema lifecycle/recovery-only stack item.
- Does not submit PR5 opt-in workflow worker loop as a separately promoted stack item.
- Does not decide durable runtime product direction beyond implementing the accepted PR1 boundary.

## Base / diff reconciliation

- PR2 is maintained as a non-cumulative replay on canonical PR1 #101828, not as a cumulative stack against `main`.
- Reconciled against `origin/pr/101828` (`98ffd6a2fb`) and retained exactly the PR2 durable-runtime commits plus the QR repair commit.
- Replay conflict in `src/gateway/server-methods/agent.ts` was resolved by preserving `activeRunAbort.cleanup({ force: true })` while adding durable lifecycle close on undispatched failures.
- `git log --oneline --reverse origin/pr/101828..HEAD` now shows the PR2 replay plus repair:
  - `c851808aa3 feat(durable): add runtime foundation`
  - `c31b49c366 feat(durable): wire agent session runtime`
  - `1bb1edf8cc fix(durable): harden runtime store and controls`
  - `12a58c5ceb fix(durable): align runtime schema guardrails`
  - `099ffa5dbc fix(durable): type session effects on embedded runs`
  - `e37c3d5840 fix(chat): restore pairing QR display block`
- The QR repair restores mainline pairing QR sensitive-display behavior in `src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts`: pairing QR channel-data detection, terminal/PNG QR display block rendering, sensitive-media handling, and final/broadcast display inclusion.

## Reviewer / ClawSweeper requirements addressed

- Authored `What Problem This Solves`: included above.
- Authored proof/evidence sections: included below.
- Stored data model / migration impact: named below; this PR adds durable SQLite runtime state/tables and serialized metadata.
- ClawSweeper actionable `krab` finding: fixed by restoring the transient `openclaw_pairing_qr` assistant display block while continuing to avoid transcript persistence of QR setup code.
- Dirty/conflicting base concern: reconciled to canonical PR1 #101828 for non-cumulative review and pushed as the PR head.

## Proof matrix

| Gate | Command / artifact | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Focused QR/chat directive proof | `pnpm exec vitest run src/gateway/server-methods/chat.directive-tags.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway-methods.config.ts` | passed 2026-07-09T15:11+07; 1 file / 131 tests; `/tmp/pr2-qr-chat-directive-20260709.log` |
| Durable runtime tests | `pnpm exec vitest run src/durable src/channels/message/durable-receive.test.ts src/channels/turn/durable-delivery.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts` | passed 2026-07-09T15:12+07; 15 files / 55 tests; `/tmp/pr2-durable-tests-20260709.log` |
| Typecheck | `pnpm tsgo:core` | passed 2026-07-09T15:12+07; `/tmp/pr2-tsgo-core-20260709.log` |
| Non-cumulative commit replay | `git log --oneline --reverse origin/pr/101828..HEAD` | passed; PR2 replay commits plus QR repair on canonical PR1 #101828 |
| Diff scope | `git diff --name-status origin/pr/101828..HEAD` | passed; scoped to durable runtime/gateway/session/schema/tests plus restored chat QR display behavior |
| GitHub Real behavior proof | Actions run 29000897894 / job 86060948647 | passed after body gained authored problem/evidence sections |


## Evidence

- Focused QR/chat directive proof passed: `pnpm exec vitest run src/gateway/server-methods/chat.directive-tags.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway-methods.config.ts` — 1 file / 131 tests; artifact `/tmp/pr2-qr-chat-directive-20260709.log`.
- Durable runtime proof passed: `pnpm exec vitest run src/durable src/channels/message/durable-receive.test.ts src/channels/turn/durable-delivery.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts` — 15 files / 55 tests; artifact `/tmp/pr2-durable-tests-20260709.log`.
- Typecheck passed: `pnpm tsgo:core`; artifact `/tmp/pr2-tsgo-core-20260709.log`.
- Non-cumulative replay verified with `git log --oneline --reverse origin/pr/101828..HEAD`: PR2 replay commits plus QR repair on canonical PR1 #101828.
- Diff scope verified with `git diff --name-status origin/pr/101828..HEAD`: scoped to durable runtime/gateway/session/schema/tests plus restored chat QR display behavior.
- Live `openclaw e` proof from stack state: local-e gateway healthy, durable runtime tables populated, and recent gateway/agent/subagent runs terminal/succeeded.

## Live / `openclaw e` proof

Stack state records live proof on `openclaw e` / `local-e` for the equivalent durable runtime stack:

- Instance: `local-e` (`OpenClaw Local E Xu Sandbox`), gateway observed on port `37105`.
- Worktree/head in state: `/Users/avo/aicos/providers/openclaw/worktrees/openclaw-durable-runtime-recovery-pr4-v2` at `9b2f268caf`, containing the PR2 durable-runtime equivalent noted in stack state.
- `pnpm exec vitest run src/durable/*.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts`: passed; 15 files / 55 tests.
- `./openclaw.mjs gateway call health --url ws://127.0.0.1:37105 --token '[redacted]' --json`: passed; live gateway healthy, Discord Xu connected, defaultAgentId `xu`, version `2026.6.11 / 9b2f268`.
- Local-e SQLite durable state proof passed: durable runtime tables had live rows and recent gateway/agent/subagent runs were terminal/succeeded.

## Risk / upgrade notes

- Persistent data-model change: durable SQLite tables and serialized runtime metadata require maintainer upgrade/default review.
- Operator/read gateway surfaces and env knobs add support/compatibility risk.
- Pairing QR display is intentionally sensitive/transient: the QR image/terminal block is broadcast for display, but the focused proof verifies QR setup data is not persisted into transcript content.
- Durable behavior should remain feature-flagged/default-safe according to the final implementation.

## Next gate

ClawSweeper re-review requested after the QR repair, proof reruns, PR body standardization, and push. PR3 remains gated until PR2 reaches the `gold_shrimp_schrimp` threshold.
